info.title: R.E.P.O. REST API
info.description: Standalone BepInEx 5 plugin with REPOLib 4.2.0. No TikTools runtime dependency. All endpoints require the configured bearer token by default. Gameplay mutations require host authority and a generated playable level. Runtime and multiplayer validation status is in docs/TESTING.md.

get.description: HTTP readiness remains ready before any level is loaded. game readiness requires a generated playable level and host authority. This request also uses the Unity dispatcher; a stalled Unity loop returns 504.

200.description: Completed on the game thread. Mutation results state the confirmed scope of execution.

400.description: Invalid JSON, quantity, position, unknown field, query or missing idempotency key.

404.description: Unknown route, object, player or API-owned enemy.

409.description: No active level, host required, changed session, lost ownership or reused idempotency key with different body.

422.description: No safe position or usable prefab collision bounds.

500.description: Execution failed; details may contain confirmed partial spawn results.

503.description: Shutdown, full command queue, HTTP or idempotency capacity.

504.description: Command expired before executing. No action performed.

Position.description: Placement is validated against prefab collider bounds and floor geometry; enemies also require a nearby NavMesh. world_position preserves x/z and projects y onto a nearby floor; it is rejected when occupied. Multiple objects cannot occupy the same explicit world position.

id.description: Opaque ID, valid only while this player remains in this scene/session.
